text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I... have been defeated! What a tragedy! 
To think I could draw out an opponent's 
hidden potential like that—as expected of 
me! Thanks to that, the race was a 
thrilling spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I've secured a worthy rival capable of 
delivering a battle hotter than the 
"Golden Generation"—yet she declined! She 
must be shy about the honor of running 
alongside a king.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
However, the winds of the era are blowing 
in my favor! Even without a worthy rival, 
the crowd is in a frenzy... waiting for 
the bell marking the change of generations 
to chime!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go ring that bell. Toward the 
Arima Kinen—where the "Golden Generation" 
awaits!
